<skill_instructions>
# 云枢参考图片与视频复刻
除非用户明确指定其他输出语言，否则默认使用简体中文。创作要求、人物设定、素材说明、分镜标题、场景、景别与运镜、人物动作、生成提示词、进度和工具调用说明均遵从这个语言。英文草稿、模型名或专业指南不能自行切换输出语言。保留用户指定的台词、歌词、字幕和画面文字的原文；模型协议字段名、特殊标签、模型名和资源标识保持原拼写。直接按该语言完成规划与生成，不额外调用模型进行翻译。
结合完整对话理解创作意图，不要求用户使用固定句式或反复重述数量。未指定数量默认一条；用户明确需要几条成片，就先用 prepare_video_works 准备对应数量，再逐个使用返回的 work_id 生成。单条简单请求可以直接生成，Host 自动准备一个默认作品编号。作品编号用于同一成片的防重复，不是从用户措辞推算的权限额度。普通确认、修改参数和继续同一作品时复用已有 work_id；尚未提交时可以纠正参数，已提交或结果未知时只查询、恢复原任务，不通过换工具调用或重新准备编号再生成。台词、字幕和故事里的疑问或否定不代表取消。准备同一请求会返回原作品清单，不增加版本；若已准备清单后，用户在真实问题回答中明确增加数量，先核对已有清单，再用 append_video_works 追加缺少的条数（已有一条改为总共三条时追加两条），保留原 work_id 和未知任务。同一回答重复追加不会再次加片，不能把普通确认、查询或重试当作追加指令。非 H3 报价选择只批准当前一件作品，追加作品分别核对实际报价；用户另行发起独立新请求时可以准备新的清单，即使提示词或计划相同，也不受旧任务等待或未知影响。清单中的待办不是必须执行的订单；用户减少数量时只启动其仍要求的作品，未启动的多余编号可以保留，不能为了清空清单生成。不要为了填满并发、质量评价或修改计划自动增加收费作品。是否另做仍不明确时只简短确认，不把正常对话说成平台拒绝。

## 先分析用户实际提供的证据
适用于爆款图片复刻、对标视频复刻、商品/人物替换、画风与分镜重建、图像主体沿参考视频动作迁移。用户只要求分析、拆解、出方案或改提示词时，只读取证据并保存计划，不上传、不报价、不生成。用户明确要求开始生成或确认方案后，才沿原计划执行；确认不增加作品数量。
按实际文件名和附件顺序列出素材：源图/风格图、对标视频、商品素材、人物素材、首帧/尾帧等。逐项写明采用、排除和可修改内容；不要将图片和视频混作同一素材角色，也不要杜撰未收到的素材或图片内容。先通过现有图片读取/查看工具看真实源图。视频若在附件存储区，先通过现有文件工具将当前聊天已获读取授权的附件正常复制到工作区，调用 inspect_reference_video，再读取/查看返回的实际帧路径，保留每帧 time_seconds 和真实 duration_seconds。不能绕过附件授权直接读取原生路径、私有媒体、任意主机文件或网上猜测的地址。

调用 update_creation_plan，包含必需 kind、title、brief、shots，每个shot有id、order、title、prompt。brief保留用户原始要求、明确模型/偏好、作品数量、复刻目标与已观察/推断/未知；assets的source_path_or_asset_id绑定真实源文件，prompt说明素材职责、保留与替换规则；shots保存逐段时间与动作、构图、运镜和待确认限制。分析得到的抽帧是证据，不能自动代替原视频作为动作输入。后续修改先get_creation_plan并保留原plan_id、素材/镜头id、已完成产物和原操作编号，不维护脱节的第二份分镜。
严格区分“动作迁移”和“风格/分镜重建”。用户给出主体图加动作对标视频并要求复刻动作时，必须选择当前目录明确支持图+视频的动作迁移/复刻操作，把主体图和原视频分别绑定其声明角色。只看抽帧再文生视频不等于动作迁移；不支持时说明缺口，不能丢弃视频改为纯文本。用户只要求借鉴风格、构图或分镜时，说明是重建而非精确动作复制；按其目标使用原图/视频和对应原生能力。商品与人物替换要逐项说明哪个主体身份保持、哪个被替换、姿态/场景/文字是否保留，不继承用户要求排除的标语、价格、水印或声音。

## 读取精确模型、素材角色与报价后执行
保留用户显式选择的模型；未指定时先读取实际个人媒体偏好和当前目录，不让用户重复已保存的选择。用 list_media_models_v2 获取可执行型号，再带精确model读取完整 parameters_schema、asset_fields、conditions、intent、尺寸/时长和上传限制，之后才为每项素材调用upload_media_asset绑定精确field，并调用quote_media_operation。名称相近不代表能力相同；不能凭示例猜字段、压平嵌套参数、乱用首尾帧槽、遗漏必需视频或用收费试调用探测能力。没有合适能力或可核实报价时保留方案并报告缺口。
未指定数量默认一条；明确几条作品才做几条。分镜数量、抽帧数量、并发容量、质量检查或修改方案都不能自动新增收费版本。按照所选规格支持的最长合适单段时长减少付费片段，优先减少拼接，再减少多余生成秒数；多个视觉镜头可以写进同一单段提示词。尊重用户明确时长和静态参数，不静默切模型。并发仅加快既定作品/片段，不增加其数量。
向用户展示材料角色、保留/替换规则、实际模型/时长/规格、复刻方式、未知限制及精确报价。需要确认时等待当前方案确认；用户已经明确要求生成且无需额外选择时直接沿该方案执行，不要求重复授权。仅分析请求即使已经形成完整方案也不能进入生成。
V2报价返回的client_operation_id是这件作品的原操作身份。将它记回原计划brief或对应shot.prompt，与真实素材、参数和报价对应；确认后只用generate_media_operation执行该原编号。V2不走generate_video_project、generate_video或legacy resume_video_project；不能新建work_key绕开已接受、未知或中断的操作。普通确认、参数修订、查结果与保存失败恢复都保留同一计划和已有身份。未受理的参数修订遵从原quote允许的条件，不改写已受理请求。
已接受、提交未知、查询超时、404或部分保存失败时，只调用query_media_operation查询并保存原client_operation_id的全部产物，不另POST、不换模型、不盲用legacy resume、不新建work_key。停止本地等待不证明上游取消或退款。用户后来另行明确发起的新作品与原操作独立，不能把普通确认解释为新作品。
呈现实际返回的全部产物路径并链接文件，保留GIF、图层和其他输出，不只取第一项。成片必须真实查看后才评价画面；听过并对照时点后才评价声音、对白和口型，否则列为未核实。用已观察差异提出定向修改方案，修改方案本身不触发重新收费生成。

输出分为“已观察”“推断”“未知”：已观察只描述实际源图与带时间点抽样帧可见内容；推断说明依据；未知列出未核实的动作中段、声音、台词、节奏、口型和完整转场。抽出三个静态帧不代表看完全部动作或听过音频；容器时长、存在音轨也不能证明对白或同步正确。没有真实视听能力时明确限制，不补写为已看过、已听过。

## 将分析保存为同一份可执行计划
调用 update_creation_plan，包含必需 kind、title、brief、shots，每个shot有id、order、title、prompt。brief保留用户原始要求、明确模型/偏好、作品数量、复刻目标与已观察/推断/未知；assets的source_path_or_asset_id绑定真实源文件，prompt说明素材职责、保留与替换规则；shots保存逐段时间与动作、构图、运镜和待确认限制。分析得到的抽帧是证据，不能自动代替原视频作为动作输入。后续修改先get_creation_plan并保留原plan_id、素材/镜头id、已完成产物和原操作编号，不维护脱节的第二份分镜。
严格区分“动作迁移”和“风格/分镜重建”。用户给出主体图加动作对标视频并要求复刻动作时，必须选择当前目录明确支持图+视频的动作迁移/复刻操作，把主体图和原视频分别绑定其声明角色。只看抽帧再文生视频不等于动作迁移；不支持时说明缺口，不能丢弃视频改为纯文本。用户只要求借鉴风格、构图或分镜时，说明是重建而非精确动作复制；按其目标使用原图/视频和对应原生能力。商品与人物替换要逐项说明哪个主体身份保持、哪个被替换、姿态/场景/文字是否保留，不继承用户要求排除的标语、价格、水印或声音。

## 读取精确模型、素材角色与报价后执行
保留用户显式选择的模型；未指定时先读取实际个人媒体偏好和当前目录，不让用户重复已保存的选择。用 list_media_models_v2 获取可执行型号，再带精确model读取完整 parameters_schema、asset_fields、conditions、intent、尺寸/时长和上传限制，之后才为每项素材调用upload_media_asset绑定精确field，并调用quote_media_operation。名称相近不代表能力相同；不能凭示例猜字段、压平嵌套参数、乱用首尾帧槽、遗漏必需视频或用收费试调用探测能力。没有合适能力或可核实报价时保留方案并报告缺口。
未指定数量默认一条；明确几条作品才做几条。分镜数量、抽帧数量、并发容量、质量检查或修改方案都不能自动新增收费版本。按照所选规格支持的最长合适单段时长减少付费片段，优先减少拼接，再减少多余生成秒数；多个视觉镜头可以写进同一单段提示词。尊重用户明确时长和静态参数，不静默切模型。并发仅加快既定作品/片段，不增加其数量。
向用户展示材料角色、保留/替换规则、实际模型/时长/规格、复刻方式、未知限制及精确报价。需要确认时等待当前方案确认；用户已经明确要求生成且无需额外选择时直接沿该方案执行，不要求重复授权。仅分析请求即使已经形成完整方案也不能进入生成。
V2报价返回的client_operation_id是这件作品的原操作身份。将它记回原计划brief或对应shot.prompt，与真实素材、参数和报价对应；确认后只用generate_media_operation执行该原编号。V2不走generate_video_project、generate_video或legacy resume_video_project；不能新建work_key绕开已接受、未知或中断的操作。普通确认、参数修订、查结果与保存失败恢复都保留同一计划和已有身份。未受理的参数修订遵从原quote允许的条件，不改写已受理请求。
已接受、提交未知、查询超时、404或部分保存失败时，只调用query_media_operation查询并保存原client_operation_id的全部产物，不另POST、不换模型、不盲用legacy resume、不新建work_key。停止本地等待不证明上游取消或退款。用户后来另行明确发起的新作品与原操作独立，不能把普通确认解释为新作品。
呈现实际返回的全部产物路径并链接文件，保留GIF、图层和其他输出，不只取第一项。成片必须真实查看后才评价画面；听过并对照时点后才评价声音、对白和口型，否则列为未核实。用已观察差异提出定向修改方案，修改方案本身不触发重新收费生成。

Read the current works first. The Host binds this revision to the exact real answer captured for this execution; repeating it or changing tool-call ids cannot append twice. An answer already used to prepare the list cannot append another copy. Existing work ids, UNKNOWN submissions and operation ids remain unchanged. Use returned pending_work_ids for genuinely new works and query original existing works. Do not append for retries, quality review, parameter correction or concurrency. A new independent human message prepares its own list with prepare_video_works instead. This tool neither generates nor approves a model price; each new non-H3 work still requires its actual quote and human choice.

count.description: Positive whole number of ADDITIONAL finished works explicitly requested by the later real human answer, excluding all existing works. For a change from one to three, use two.

tools.name: cancel_video_project
tools.description: Stop this account, workspace and chat's original local video project and wait for all in-flight submissions to settle before reading its latest saved task ids. Request cancellation only for original server queue ids; report cancellation only when the gateway confirms the item was never dispatched. Already dispatching, legacy and uncertain tasks retain their original ids and may continue running and billing. This never resubmits work or promises a refund.

replace_all.description: Replace all matches. Defaults to false; when false, old_string must appear exactly once.

tools.name: edit_video
tools.description: Edit existing local videos without generating new media or spending model credits. Order clips as supplied, optionally trim each start/end in seconds, normalize and concatenate them, and optionally trim the final length. Input files must be readable inside this workspace or an owned generated-video project. Returns a background job_id; wait for the real final_path, then call present and include the artifact link. This performs ordered cuts and joins; it does not synthesize unseen footage, music, subtitles, or effects. If current user-supplied chat attachments are outside the workspace, first copy only those read-authorized attachments into this workspace with existing file tools, then edit the copied paths.

clips.description: Local clip paths in final playback order, with optional per-clip trim positions. Copy current user-supplied, read-authorized chat attachments from outside the workspace into the workspace with existing file tools before passing their copied paths.

total_duration_seconds.description: Optional final duration after assembling clips; cannot exceed the available trimmed footage.

tools.name: generate_media_operation
tools.description: Submit the exact quoted V2 media operation requested by the human, once. Supply only its original client_operation_id; this cannot change the model, references or parameters. Accepted/unknown original records are queried, never resubmitted. A normal pending task returns immediately: use query_media_operation at measured intervals and present all real returned paths. Do not call another generator, provider or new work_key to wait for this result. Every requested output remains part of this original operation, including GIF/layers/processed video.

tools.name: generate_video_project
tools.description: Default fixed background workflow for every new chat video, including a single short clip and a finished video longer than one model clip. Default to one finished work. For several user-requested works, first prepare_video_works with the concrete count and use each returned work_id once. This tool starts one finished work per invocation; clips and gateway concurrency never add works. Reuse work_id when continuing, correcting or retrying the same finished work. Its durable claim survives new tool-call ids and restarts; an existing work returns original task coordinates without a new generation POST. A new actual human request can prepare independent work even with the same prompt, plan or shots, and an earlier unknown task cannot block it. Natural-language phrasing and inferred work totals are not permission gates. pending_work_ids identifies concrete prepared works still available to start; start only those still requested by the user, without waiting for earlier jobs. If the user reduces the count, leave unwanted prepared works unstarted; never generate merely to empty this list. remaining_works counts that list, not a user allowance. Query or resume accepted and unknown original projects instead of generating again. For a simple single-clip brief without an explicit duration, call this tool directly with prompt and any requested model or references; omit total_duration_seconds so the Host resolves actual defaults in one call. Do not load directing skills, write a long storyboard or call list_video_models first for that simple case. For explicit timing or complex plans, read list_video_models for the effective default_model_id, selected_parameters and that model’s own actual controls before splitting clips. An incomplete-default error preserves its selected model; choose from that same model’s complete specifications rather than switching to H3. A model conflict requires correcting the unsubmitted selection, not trying alternative paid combinations. Never discover support by paid retries, inspect installed application archives for a creation request, or silently replace an explicitly named model. Use the yunshu-video-director skill for story, character/reference continuity, dialogue and subtitles, then call this native workflow; do not write polling, download or assembly scripts or manually repeat generate_video for each visual cut. One paid clip can contain several camera beats. A saved seconds preference chooses a single clip only when no final duration was requested; it never caps clip length for a timed project. With a requested total, use the full duration menu for the selected resolution, ratio, quality and mode: first minimize paid clips, then surplus seconds. A supported 15-second work is one 15-second clip even when the saved default is five seconds. For requests such as a 40-second video, plan the fewest supported clips (for a 15-second limit: 15+15+10, or three 15-second clips trimmed to 40), generate independent clips with gateway-approved bounded parallelism using the signed-in account, then normalize, trim, and join them in timeline order. Without a valid gateway declaration, concurrency defaults to four clips. Respect verified pool capacity and any lower local or gateway ceiling. The API owns shared account capacity. Do not launch a separate agent or generation-tool call for every clip. For a catalog with H3 single clips limited to 4–15 seconds, 60 seconds means four 15-second clips, never one 30-second clip. All local tools and every request are checked before billing. Returns a background job_id and durable project_id; read job_output at measured intervals for queued/generating progress and call present on the completed final_path. A busy response without an accepted task id is unknown, not confirmed queue admission. Use job_kill when the user stops; accepted provider tasks may continue billing. A query deadline retains task ids for explicit resume, never a fresh submission. Never claim completion before the job reports a saved final_path. If a current user-supplied chat attachment is outside the workspace, first copy that read-authorized attachment into this workspace with the existing file tools, then pass the copied path; do not copy unrelated files.结合完整对话理解创作意图，不要求用户使用固定句式或反复重述数量。未指定数量默认一条；用户明确需要几条成片，就先用 prepare_video_works 准备对应数量，再逐个使用返回的 work_id 生成。单条简单请求可以直接生成，Host 自动准备一个默认作品编号。作品编号用于同一成片的防重复，不是从用户措辞推算的权限额度。普通确认、修改参数和继续同一作品时复用已有 work_id；尚未提交时可以纠正参数，已提交或结果未知时只查询、恢复原任务，不通过换工具调用或重新准备编号再生成。台词、字幕和故事里的疑问或否定不代表取消。准备同一请求会返回原作品清单，不增加版本；若已准备清单后，用户在真实问题回答中明确增加数量，先核对已有清单，再用 append_video_works 追加缺少的条数（已有一条改为总共三条时追加两条），保留原 work_id 和未知任务。同一回答重复追加不会再次加片，不能把普通确认、查询或重试当作追加指令。非 H3 报价选择只批准当前一件作品，追加作品分别核对实际报价；用户另行发起独立新请求时可以准备新的清单，即使提示词或计划相同，也不受旧任务等待或未知影响。清单中的待办不是必须执行的订单；用户减少数量时只启动其仍要求的作品，未启动的多余编号可以保留，不能为了清空清单生成。不要为了填满并发、质量评价或修改计划自动增加收费作品。是否另做仍不明确时只简短确认，不把正常对话说成平台拒绝。

When omitted for an explicit creation plan, use its saved shot durations; do not silently change that timeline.

model.description: The current human request overrides the frozen personal video preference, then the backend-configured video model for this account; an older or unset configuration retains MiniMax-H3. mode.description: Published vendor mode, only when supported.

seed.description: Safe integer random seed, only when declared by the selected model.

watermark.description: Watermark switch, only when declared by the selected model.

audio.description: Optional requested audio state from list_video_models, not a capability probe. Sent as a switch only when the chosen model declares one; fixed native audio accepts only its declared state. No switch does not mean silent output; an undeclared audio state remains unknown. Do not blindly send true, and do not promise speech, lip-sync, subtitles or silence without checking the media.

For a user-supplied chat attachment outside the workspace, first copy the read-authorized attachment into the workspace with existing file tools and pass its copied path.

tools.description: Read executable native image/video/audio generation and processing models, exact operation intents, complete recursive JSON schemas, conditions, asset roles/limits and indicative pricing. This is free. Use this path for motion replication, reference video, lip-sync/avatar, super-resolution, layer decomposition and other native controls not declared by legacy image/video tools. Ordinary mode/quality values remain distinct from text/reference/frames/transform intent. Never discover support through a paid trial. Without model, return a compact overview. Then call again with the exact model ID for its full typed schema and conditions before selecting parameters; preserve nested objects, arrays, ordered frames and declared values exactly, and follow all required/conditional fields; do not put every model schema into chat context. Follow with upload_media_asset for real materials and quote_media_operation for exact product credits.

tools.name: prepare_video_works
tools.description: Prepare concrete finished-video work ids without generation or billing. Omit count for one finished video. When the user requests several works, interpret the full conversation and prepare that complete count before starting any work, then pass a different returned work_id for each finished work. This is a concrete work list, not a language-based permission or quota. Repeating preparation under the same human source returns the original list even with another tool-call id; it never creates extra versions or resets a submitted work. Reuse existing work_id values for confirmations, parameter corrections, queries and recovery. A separate actual human request can prepare an independent list even with the same prompt or plan. Do not prepare again to retry an unknown submission; query its original operation or project. For a later real answer requesting additional works, use append_video_works with the missing count; do not reset existing identities. Only the Host assigns work identities.

count.description: Concrete positive whole number of finished works requested in the conversation. Defaults to one. Shot count, clip count and concurrency do not increase this value. Prepare the complete work list before generating its first work.

tools.name: query_media_operation
tools.description: Read the exact original V2 operation/task and save every original output when ready. This never generates media. Pending, unknown, 404, timeout and partial downloads retain the operation; recover again with the same ID rather than resubmitting. GIF remains animated, vectors are files and every layer/output is returned. No first-output slicing.

tools.name: quote_media_operation
tools.description: Obtain an exact free native-media quote before generation. Read list_media_models_v2, preserve every selected field and ordered asset ID, and supply the declared intent. Reference/frames/transform with missing materials is rejected; never substitute text. Parameters contain only fields declared by the exact model schema, including nested objects, arrays, null or prompt only when that schema accepts them. Preserve recursive structure, array order and values; do not stringify objects, flatten frames, truncate arrays or invent fields. Check model conditions and material constraints before quoting; an unsupported reference remains a reference error, never text fallback. Asset bindings are separate exact field -> ordered asset_id arrays, including singleton fields. Omit client_operation_id for the first quote: Host assigns one stable operation for this actual human request/model/work_key. Repeated calls recover the original record even with a different tool-call ID. Reuse that ID for quote correction, generation and recovery. work_key identifies a concrete separately requested output, not an attempt counter; native count belongs in parameters. Do not invent another work_key to retry an unknown or accepted task. No generation or wallet reservation occurs here.

<skill_instructions>
# 云枢参考图片与视频复刻
除非用户明确指定其他输出语言，否则默认使用简体中文。创作要求、人物设定、素材说明、分镜标题、场景、景别与运镜、人物动作、生成提示词、进度和工具调用说明均遵从这个语言。英文草稿、模型名或专业指南不能自行切换输出语言。保留用户指定的台词、歌词、字幕和画面文字的原文；模型协议字段名、特殊标签、模型名和资源标识保持原拼写。直接按该语言完成规划与生成，不额外调用模型进行翻译。
结合完整对话理解创作意图，不要求用户使用固定句式或反复重述数量。未指定数量默认一条；用户明确需要几条成片，就先用 prepare_video_works 准备对应数量，再逐个使用返回的 work_id 生成。单条简单请求可以直接生成，Host 自动准备一个默认作品编号。作品编号用于同一成片的防重复，不是从用户措辞推算的权限额度。普通确认、修改参数和继续同一作品时复用已有 work_id；尚未提交时可以纠正参数，已提交或结果未知时只查询、恢复原任务，不通过换工具调用或重新准备编号再生成。台词、字幕和故事里的疑问或否定不代表取消。准备同一请求会返回原作品清单，不增加版本；若已准备清单后，用户在真实问题回答中明确增加数量，先核对已有清单，再用 append_video_works 追加缺少的条数（已有一条改为总共三条时追加两条），保留原 work_id 和未知任务。同一回答重复追加不会再次加片，不能把普通确认、查询或重试当作追加指令。非 H3 报价选择只批准当前一件作品，追加作品分别核对实际报价；用户另行发起独立新请求时可以准备新的清单，即使提示词或计划相同，也不受旧任务等待或未知影响。清单中的待办不是必须执行的订单；用户减少数量时只启动其仍要求的作品，未启动的多余编号可以保留，不能为了清空清单生成。不要为了填满并发、质量评价或修改计划自动增加收费作品。是否另做仍不明确时只简短确认，不把正常对话说成平台拒绝。

## 先分析用户实际提供的证据
适用于爆款图片复刻、对标视频复刻、商品/人物替换、画风与分镜重建、图像主体沿参考视频动作迁移。用户只要求分析、拆解、出方案或改提示词时，只读取证据并保存计划，不上传、不报价、不生成。用户明确要求开始生成或确认方案后，才沿原计划执行；确认不增加作品数量。
按实际文件名和附件顺序列出素材：源图/风格图、对标视频、商品素材、人物素材、首帧/尾帧等。逐项写明采用、排除和可修改内容；不要将图片和视频混作同一素材角色，也不要杜撰未收到的素材或图片内容。先通过现有图片读取/查看工具看真实源图。视频若在附件存储区，先通过现有文件工具将当前聊天已获读取授权的附件正常复制到工作区，调用 inspect_reference_video，再读取/查看返回的实际帧路径，保留每帧 time_seconds 和真实 duration_seconds。不能绕过附件授权直接读取原生路径、私有媒体、任意主机文件或网上猜测的地址。
输出分为“已观察”“推断”“未知”：已观察只描述实际源图与带时间点抽样帧可见内容；推断说明依据；未知列出未核实的动作中段、声音、台词、节奏、口型和完整转场。抽出三个静态帧不代表看完全部动作或听过音频；容器时长、存在音轨也不能证明对白或同步正确。没有真实视听能力时明确限制，不补写为已看过、已听过。

## 将分析保存为同一份可执行计划
调用 update_creation_plan，包含必需 kind、title、brief、shots，每个shot有id、order、title、prompt。brief保留用户原始要求、明确模型/偏好、作品数量、复刻目标与已观察/推断/未知；assets的source_path_or_asset_id绑定真实源文件，prompt说明素材职责、保留与替换规则；shots保存逐段时间与动作、构图、运镜和待确认限制。分析得到的抽帧是证据，不能自动代替原视频作为动作输入。后续修改先get_creation_plan并保留原plan_id、素材/镜头id、已完成产物和原操作编号，不维护脱节的第二份分镜。
严格区分“动作迁移”和“风格/分镜重建”。用户给出主体图加动作对标视频并要求复刻动作时，必须选择当前目录明确支持图+视频的动作迁移/复刻操作，把主体图和原视频分别绑定其声明角色。只看抽帧再文生视频不等于动作迁移；不支持时说明缺口，不能丢弃视频改为纯文本。用户只要求借鉴风格、构图或分镜时，说明是重建而非精确动作复制；按其目标使用原图/视频和对应原生能力。商品与人物替换要逐项说明哪个主体身份保持、哪个被替换、姿态/场景/文字是否保留，不继承用户要求排除的标语、价格、水印或声音。

## 读取精确模型、素材角色与报价后执行
保留用户显式选择的模型；未指定时先读取实际个人媒体偏好和当前目录，不让用户重复已保存的选择。用 list_media_models_v2 获取可执行型号，再带精确model读取完整 parameters_schema、asset_fields、conditions、intent、尺寸/时长和上传限制，之后才为每项素材调用upload_media_asset绑定精确field，并调用quote_media_operation。名称相近不代表能力相同；不能凭示例猜字段、压平嵌套参数、乱用首尾帧槽、遗漏必需视频或用收费试调用探测能力。没有合适能力或可核实报价时保留方案并报告缺口。
未指定数量默认一条；明确几条作品才做几条。分镜数量、抽帧数量、并发容量、质量检查或修改方案都不能自动新增收费版本。按照所选规格支持的最长合适单段时长减少付费片段，优先减少拼接，再减少多余生成秒数；多个视觉镜头可以写进同一单段提示词。尊重用户明确时长和静态参数，不静默切模型。并发仅加快既定作品/片段，不增加其数量。
向用户展示材料角色、保留/替换规则、实际模型/时长/规格、复刻方式、未知限制及精确报价。需要确认时等待当前方案确认；用户已经明确要求生成且无需额外选择时直接沿该方案执行，不要求重复授权。仅分析请求即使已经形成完整方案也不能进入生成。
V2报价返回的client_operation_id是这件作品的原操作身份。将它记回原计划brief或对应shot.prompt，与真实素材、参数和报价对应；确认后只用generate_media_operation执行该原编号。V2不走generate_video_project、generate_video或legacy resume_video_project；不能新建work_key绕开已接受、未知或中断的操作。普通确认、参数修订、查结果与保存失败恢复都保留同一计划和已有身份。未受理的参数修订遵从原quote允许的条件，不改写已受理请求。
已接受、提交未知、查询超时、404或部分保存失败时，只调用query_media_operation查询并保存原client_operation_id的全部产物，不另POST、不换模型、不盲用legacy resume、不新建work_key。停止本地等待不证明上游取消或退款。用户后来另行明确发起的新作品与原操作独立，不能把普通确认解释为新作品。
呈现实际返回的全部产物路径并链接文件，保留GIF、图层和其他输出，不只取第一项。成片必须真实查看后才评价画面；听过并对照时点后才评价声音、对白和口型，否则列为未核实。用已观察差异提出定向修改方案，修改方案本身不触发重新收费生成。

tools.description: Edit existing local videos without generating new media or spending model credits. Order clips as supplied, optionally trim each start/end in seconds, normalize and concatenate them, and optionally trim the final length. Input files must be readable inside this workspace or an owned generated-video project. Returns a background job_id; wait for the real final_path, then call present and include the artifact link. This performs ordered cuts and joins; it does not synthesize unseen footage, music, subtitles, or effects. tools.name: generate_media_operation
tools.description: Submit the exact quoted V2 media operation requested by the human, once. Supply only its original client_operation_id; this cannot change the model, references or parameters. Accepted/unknown original records are queried, never resubmitted. A normal pending task returns immediately: use query_media_operation at measured intervals and present all real returned paths. Do not call another generator, provider or new work_key to wait for this result. Every requested output remains part of this original operation, including GIF/layers/processed video.

tools.name: generate_video_project
tools.description: Default fixed background workflow for every new chat video, including a single short clip and a finished video longer than one model clip. Default to one finished work. For several user-requested works, first prepare_video_works with the concrete count and use each returned work_id once. This tool starts one finished work per invocation; clips and gateway concurrency never add works. Reuse work_id when continuing, correcting or retrying the same finished work. Its durable claim survives new tool-call ids and restarts; an existing work returns original task coordinates without a new generation POST. A new actual human request can prepare independent work even with the same prompt, plan or shots, and an earlier unknown task cannot block it. Natural-language phrasing and inferred work totals are not permission gates. pending_work_ids identifies concrete prepared works still available to start; start only those still requested by the user, without waiting for earlier jobs. If the user reduces the count, leave unwanted prepared works unstarted; never generate merely to empty this list. remaining_works counts that list, not a user allowance. Query or resume accepted and unknown original projects instead of generating again. For a simple single-clip brief without an explicit duration, call this tool directly with prompt and any requested model or references; omit total_duration_seconds so the Host resolves actual defaults in one call. Do not load directing skills, write a long storyboard or call list_video_models first for that simple case. For explicit timing or complex plans, read list_video_models for the effective default_model_id, selected_parameters and that model’s own actual controls before splitting clips. An incomplete-default error preserves its selected model; choose from that same model’s complete specifications rather than switching to H3. A model conflict requires correcting the unsubmitted selection, not trying alternative paid combinations. Never discover support by paid retries, inspect installed application archives for a creation request, or silently replace an explicitly named model. Use the yunshu-video-director skill for story, character/reference continuity, dialogue and subtitles, then call this native workflow; do not write polling, download or assembly scripts or manually repeat generate_video for each visual cut. One paid clip can contain several camera beats. A saved seconds preference chooses a single clip only when no final duration was requested; it never caps clip length for a timed project. With a requested total, use the full duration menu for the selected resolution, ratio, quality and mode: first minimize paid clips, then surplus seconds. A supported 15-second work is one 15-second clip even when the saved default is five seconds. For requests such as a 40-second video, plan the fewest supported clips (for a 15-second limit: 15+15+10, or three 15-second clips trimmed to 40), generate independent clips with gateway-approved bounded parallelism using the signed-in account, then normalize, trim, and join them in timeline order. Without a valid gateway declaration, concurrency defaults to four clips. Respect verified pool capacity and any lower local or gateway ceiling. The API owns shared account capacity. Do not launch a separate agent or generation-tool call for every clip. For a catalog with H3 single clips limited to 4–15 seconds, 60 seconds means four 15-second clips, never one 30-second clip. All local tools and every request are checked before billing. Returns a background job_id and durable project_id; read job_output at measured intervals for queued/generating progress and call present on the completed final_path. <skill_instructions>
# 云枢参考图片与视频复刻
除非用户明确指定其他输出语言，否则默认使用简体中文。创作要求、人物设定、素材说明、分镜标题、场景、景别与运镜、人物动作、生成提示词、进度和工具调用说明均遵从这个语言。英文草稿、模型名或专业指南不能自行切换输出语言。保留用户指定的台词、歌词、字幕和画面文字的原文；模型协议字段名、特殊标签、模型名和资源标识保持原拼写。直接按该语言完成规划与生成，不额外调用模型进行翻译。
结合完整对话理解创作意图，不要求用户使用固定句式或反复重述数量。未指定数量默认一条；用户明确需要几条成片，就先用 prepare_video_works 准备对应数量，再逐个使用返回的 work_id 生成。单条简单请求可以直接生成，Host 自动准备一个默认作品编号。作品编号用于同一成片的防重复，不是从用户措辞推算的权限额度。普通确认、修改参数和继续同一作品时复用已有 work_id；尚未提交时可以纠正参数，已提交或结果未知时只查询、恢复原任务，不通过换工具调用或重新准备编号再生成。台词、字幕和故事里的疑问或否定不代表取消。准备同一请求会返回原作品清单，不增加版本；若已准备清单后，用户在真实问题回答中明确增加数量，先核对已有清单，再用 append_video_works 追加缺少的条数（已有一条改为总共三条时追加两条），保留原 work_id 和未知任务。同一回答重复追加不会再次加片，不能把普通确认、查询或重试当作追加指令。非 H3 报价选择只批准当前一件作品，追加作品分别核对实际报价；用户另行发起独立新请求时可以准备新的清单，即使提示词或计划相同，也不受旧任务等待或未知影响。清单中的待办不是必须执行的订单；用户减少数量时只启动其仍要求的作品，未启动的多余编号可以保留，不能为了清空清单生成。不要为了填满并发、质量评价或修改计划自动增加收费作品。是否另做仍不明确时只简短确认，不把正常对话说成平台拒绝。

## 先分析用户实际提供的证据
适用于爆款图片复刻、对标视频复刻、商品/人物替换、画风与分镜重建、图像主体沿参考视频动作迁移。用户只要求分析、拆解、出方案或改提示词时，只读取证据并保存计划，不上传、不报价、不生成。用户明确要求开始生成或确认方案后，才沿原计划执行；确认不增加作品数量。
按实际文件名和附件顺序列出素材：源图/风格图、对标视频、商品素材、人物素材、首帧/尾帧等。逐项写明采用、排除和可修改内容；不要将图片和视频混作同一素材角色，也不要杜撰未收到的素材或图片内容。先通过现有图片读取/查看工具看真实源图。视频若在附件存储区，先通过现有文件工具将当前聊天已获读取授权的附件正常复制到工作区，调用 inspect_reference_video，再读取/查看返回的实际帧路径，保留每帧 time_seconds 和真实 duration_seconds。不能绕过附件授权直接读取原生路径、私有媒体、任意主机文件或网上猜测的地址。
输出分为“已观察”“推断”“未知”：已观察只描述实际源图与带时间点抽样帧可见内容；推断说明依据；未知列出未核实的动作中段、声音、台词、节奏、口型和完整转场。抽出三个静态帧不代表看完全部动作或听过音频；容器时长、存在音轨也不能证明对白或同步正确。没有真实视听能力时明确限制，不补写为已看过、已听过。

## 将分析保存为同一份可执行计划
调用 update_creation_plan，包含必需 kind、title、brief、shots，每个shot有id、order、title、prompt。brief保留用户原始要求、明确模型/偏好、作品数量、复刻目标与已观察/推断/未知；assets的source_path_or_asset_id绑定真实源文件，prompt说明素材职责、保留与替换规则；shots保存逐段时间与动作、构图、运镜和待确认限制。分析得到的抽帧是证据，不能自动代替原视频作为动作输入。后续修改先get_creation_plan并保留原plan_id、素材/镜头id、已完成产物和原操作编号，不维护脱节的第二份分镜。
严格区分“动作迁移”和“风格/分镜重建”。用户给出主体图加动作对标视频并要求复刻动作时，必须选择当前目录明确支持图+视频的动作迁移/复刻操作，把主体图和原视频分别绑定其声明角色。只看抽帧再文生视频不等于动作迁移；不支持时说明缺口，不能丢弃视频改为纯文本。用户只要求借鉴风格、构图或分镜时，说明是重建而非精确动作复制；按其目标使用原图/视频和对应原生能力。商品与人物替换要逐项说明哪个主体身份保持、哪个被替换、姿态/场景/文字是否保留，不继承用户要求排除的标语、价格、水印或声音。

## 读取精确模型、素材角色与报价后执行
保留用户显式选择的模型；未指定时先读取实际个人媒体偏好和当前目录，不让用户重复已保存的选择。用 list_media_models_v2 获取可执行型号，再带精确model读取完整 parameters_schema、asset_fields、conditions、intent、尺寸/时长和上传限制，之后才为每项素材调用upload_media_asset绑定精确field，并调用quote_media_operation。名称相近不代表能力相同；不能凭示例猜字段、压平嵌套参数、乱用首尾帧槽、遗漏必需视频或用收费试调用探测能力。没有合适能力或可核实报价时保留方案并报告缺口。
未指定数量默认一条；明确几条作品才做几条。分镜数量、抽帧数量、并发容量、质量检查或修改方案都不能自动新增收费版本。按照所选规格支持的最长合适单段时长减少付费片段，优先减少拼接，再减少多余生成秒数；多个视觉镜头可以写进同一单段提示词。尊重用户明确时长和静态参数，不静默切模型。并发仅加快既定作品/片段，不增加其数量。
向用户展示材料角色、保留/替换规则、实际模型/时长/规格、复刻方式、未知限制及精确报价。需要确认时等待当前方案确认；用户已经明确要求生成且无需额外选择时直接沿该方案执行，不要求重复授权。仅分析请求即使已经形成完整方案也不能进入生成。
V2报价返回的client_operation_id是这件作品的原操作身份。将它记回原计划brief或对应shot.prompt，与真实素材、参数和报价对应；确认后只用generate_media_operation执行该原编号。V2不走generate_video_project、generate_video或legacy resume_video_project；不能新建work_key绕开已接受、未知或中断的操作。普通确认、参数修订、查结果与保存失败恢复都保留同一计划和已有身份。未受理的参数修订遵从原quote允许的条件，不改写已受理请求。
已接受、提交未知、查询超时、404或部分保存失败时，只调用query_media_operation查询并保存原client_operation_id的全部产物，不另POST、不换模型、不盲用legacy resume、不新建work_key。停止本地等待不证明上游取消或退款。用户后来另行明确发起的新作品与原操作独立，不能把普通确认解释为新作品。
呈现实际返回的全部产物路径并链接文件，保留GIF、图层和其他输出，不只取第一项。成片必须真实查看后才评价画面；听过并对照时点后才评价声音、对白和口型，否则列为未核实。用已观察差异提出定向修改方案，修改方案本身不触发重新收费生成。
</skill_instructions>
</skill_content>
